46class AgentTrace:
47 """One Splunk Agent Observability trace; every method is a no-op when the SDK is off or fails."""
48
49 def __init__(self, name: str, input_text: str, metadata: dict | None = None):
50 self.status = "disabled"
51 self.logger = None
52 self.callbacks: list = []
53 if telemetry.galileo != "configured":
54 return
55 try:
56 from galileo import GalileoLogger
57 from galileo.handlers.langchain import GalileoAsyncCallback
58 self.logger = GalileoLogger()
59 self.logger.start_trace(input=input_text, name=name, metadata={k: str(v) for k, v in (metadata or {}).items()},
60 tags=["fraud-triage", "fsi-studio"])
61 self.callbacks = [GalileoAsyncCallback(galileo_logger=self.logger, start_new_trace=False, flush_on_chain_end=False)]
62 self.status = "enabled"
63 except Exception:
64 self.logger, self.callbacks, self.status = None, [], "unavailable"
65
66 def tool(self, name: str, arguments: dict, output, started: float, *, error: bool = False) -> None:
67 if not self.logger:
68 return
69 try:
70 self.logger.add_tool_span(input=_text(arguments), output=_text(output), name=name,
71 duration_ns=int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1e9), status_code=500 if error else 200,
72 tags=["fraud-tool"])
73 except Exception:
74 pass
75
76 async def finish(self, output: str, code: int = 200) -> str:
77 if not self.logger:
78 return self.status
79 try:
80 self.logger.conclude(output=output, status_code=code, conclude_all=True)
81 uploaded = await asyncio.wait_for(self.logger.async_flush(), 8)
82 self.status = "recorded" if uploaded else "no trace recorded"
platform.fraud-trace.proves: The Galileo callback captures the Deep Agent; application tool spans and a final SDK flush belong to the same agent trace.
